question: How may the height exceed the Viṣṇu portion in five-part divisions?
premises: The Viṣṇu-part height is the baseline
The height may be greater than that baseline
inference: The height may be five parts, or greater than the height of the Viṣṇu portion.
plain_english: It may be five parts high, or higher than the height of the Viṣṇu portion.
